0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Thunder playing their first game of the season on the road. The Thunder are without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). Oklahoma City lost 1-4 to San Antonio in the 2025-26 season series and 3-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 111-103 loss in Oklahoma City on May 30, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Thunder a 45% chance of winning.
